release_notes:
v1.2.2 Release - Waveshare CAN Fixed/Variable Parser Separation & Explicit Sheet Dropdown Options.

Changes:
  - Explicit Parser Types in Sheet & UI: Direct dropdown support for 'framed', 'waveshare_can' (Variable-Length), and 'waveshare_can_20_bytes' (Fixed 20-Byte) in Excel template validations, In-App Config Editor, and Protocol Wizard.
  - False Checksum Error Elimination: Strict parser mode separation prevents variable-length CAN frames with 0xAA 0x55 sequences from triggering spurious 20-byte checksum mismatches.
  - Automatic Fixed-Mode Configuration: Selecting 'waveshare_can_20_bytes' automatically configures fixed 20-byte parsing and TX packet building without extra manual flag requirements.
  - Documentation & Manual Sync: Updated built-in manual and documentation covering all parser options and configuration columns.
